title:
P1 · WIP — To-do priority column

P0–P3 metadata, compact column, priority filter/sorting, legacy defaults, safety locks and encrypted backup support implemented. Final browser/backup checks and all seven workflows must pass before completion.

P2 · Planned — To-do notifications

Add opt-in task reminders with configurable due times and clear delivery status; ask for browser permission only on request.

P1 · Planned — Feedback analysis and replies

Persist likes/feedback, classify real issues, track improvement/reply status and support explaining already available functionality.

P1 · Planned — Temporary chats: session or one-day expiry

Make lifecycle explicit; purge expired temporary content and avoid adding it to persistent recall/backups.

P1 · Planned — Thin attachment-import progress line

Show accurate staged import progress above the askbar, with failure/cancel behavior and no fake percentages.

P3 · Planned — Life: colourful rainbow theme

Add an accessible colourful theme across the app; retain readable contrast and current default themes.

P3 · Planned — Brown and gold theme

Add a warm brown/gold palette with consistent forms, tables, syntax colours and accessibility checks.

P3 · Planned — External theme import extension

Import validated theme tokens through an optional module; reject executable content and unsafe CSS.

P1 · Planned — Smart missing-repository discovery

Validate read access for an explicitly requested unconfigured repository, report the result and offer a reviewed add-repository proposal.

P2 · Planned — Share tasks, chats and diary records

Prepare chosen formats for Teams/email or other apps, with explicit selection, redaction and user-controlled sending.

P1 · Planned — Portable structured export and import

Preserve chats, formatting, tasks, diary records, project/group hierarchy and references in a versioned importable package; secrets need separate consent/protection.

P2 · Done — Simplify workspace/project/group terminology

Workspace and Folder are now the only user-facing organizing concepts. Existing nested data preserved; browser checks and all seven workflows passed.
CI: https://github.com/abhijitxroy/aimate/actions/runs/45553917264

P2 · Planned — Explain the three-chat concurrency limit

Add concise in-app help explaining per-workspace three streams, one per chat, resource/rate-limit rationale and Stop behavior.

P2 · Planned — Idle-time improvement and healing proposals

Design opt-in idle work with explicit action boundaries, validation and a separate activity history; uncertain or externally mutating work waits for required approval.

P1 · Planned — Per-section performance and improvement dashboard

Record measured before/after latency, throughput, tokens and resource metrics by section/change; separate real measurements from synthetic benchmarks.

P2 · Planned — Initial chat naming and topic icon

Choose title/icon from initial chat text once; preserve later manual changes and document fallback behavior.

P0 · Done — Default locks for To-do and My Diary updates

Already implemented and verified: locking, reopening/reload, edit/delete and completion guards. CI: https://github.com/abhijitxroy/aimate/actions/runs/45531085801

P2 · Planned — Compare search, retrieval, analysis and visualisation

Use repeatable tasks and measurements to compare the reference Dashboard and AiMate; document gaps and prioritise improvements. Reference repository access remains required.

P3 · Planned — Daily Scrum Master voice assistant

Design an optional voice module for simple-English notes, clarification questions and available English voice/accent choices. Mic capture must be explicit; speech provider/access needs clarification before implementation.

P0 · Planned — Review a locally resolved reference Dashboard merge

Read-only pre-commit review in the existing repository/branch. Verify repository and merge state before proceeding; no unrelated repository changes, reset, merge or deployment.

P1 · Done — Separate test workflow YAML files

Already separated into unit.yml, integration.yml, regression.yml and flaky.yml on improvements/verified-backlog; all four passed. CI: https://github.com/abhijitxroy/aimate/actions/runs/45532202864

P1 · WIP — Pluggable feature modules and repository skill

Save the rule in skills/pluggable-features/SKILL.md and AGENTS.md; add registration/disable boundaries and enabled/disabled tests. Existing modules still need systematic decoupling.

P1 · Done — Separate Quality checks workflow

Separate quality.yml passed with focused Python lint, syntax checks for all JavaScript sources and generated Pages/source consistency; all four test workflows also passed.
CI: https://github.com/abhijitxroy/aimate/actions/runs/45537640913

P1 · Done — Separate Security checks workflow

Separate security.yml passed: runtime/test dependency audit reports no known findings and checksum-verified Gitleaks scans all committed history. Cryptography 50.0.2 passed isolated encryption/backup and all six workflows; no blanket exemptions.
CI: https://github.com/abhijitxroy/aimate/actions/runs/45539358519

P1 · Done — Separate Build smoke workflow

Separate build.yml passed: Pages packaging and asset references, non-root Docker image build/startup, bounded health readiness and served UI assets. Persistent startup failures still fail; all seven workflows passed. No deployment or image publication.
CI: https://github.com/abhijitxroy/aimate/actions/runs/45540336274

P1 · WIP — GPT via Bedrock live access

Optional Responses adapter, shared Bedrock key, GPT-6.2 Sol default, manual GPT-6.1 Sol fallback, metering and reviewed tools implemented. Mocked backend/browser checks pass. Actual account/model access still requires Settings → AI → GPT via Bedrock → Save & test; do not mark complete before that check.

P1 · Done — Active To-do development skill

Repo skill saved in skills/aimate-backlog/SKILL.md and linked from AGENTS.md. It checks live/source To-dos, continues actionable priorities, asks only for genuine gaps and records evidence before completion. Skill validation and all seven workflows passed.
CI: https://github.com/abhijitxroy/aimate/actions/runs/45553917292
